name: YTPTube
description: YTPTube is a self-hosted web interface and download manager for yt-dlp. It queues one-off URLs, playlists, channels and live streams, checks sources on a schedule with Tasks, stores reusable yt-dlp options as Presets and applies them by metadata with Conditions. It sends notifications through Apprise or webhooks, writes Kodi-style NFO sidecars for media libraries, and has a file browser, a built-in player, an HTTP API and browser extensions.

notes.text: There is no default login. The first visitor to the web UI creates the admin account, so open it right after the install. To reset a password, stop the service and run: cd /opt/ytptube && YTP_CONFIG_PATH=/opt/ytptube_data/config .venv/bin/python -m app.scripts.reset_password --username <name>

Downloads are saved to /opt/ytptube_data/downloads (YTP_DOWNLOAD_PATH in /etc/systemd/system/ytptube.service). To store them on a NAS or share them with Plex, Jellyfin or Emby, bind-mount the media folder there, e.g. pct set <CTID> -mp0 /mnt/media/youtube,mp=/opt/ytptube_data/downloads, then restart the container. In an unprivileged container the host folder must be writable by UID 100000.

Extra settings (YTP_* variables from the FAQ) go in /opt/ytptube_data/config/.env; the database, presets and logs live in the same folder. Everything under /opt/ytptube_data survives updates. yt-dlp is refreshed on every service start (YTP_YTDLP_AUTO_UPDATE).

The PO-token provider (bgutil) that the Docker image bundles is not installed. YouTube works without it, because yt-dlp solves its challenges with the installed deno, but the log shows a bgutil warning. To use a provider, run it elsewhere and add --extractor-args "youtubepot-bgutilhttp:base_url=http://<ip>:4416" to a preset.
